charts.title: TOI-1288 b: orbits around TOI-1288
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-1288's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-1288 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: ExoFOP, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EXOFOP): P 2.6998294 d

charts.title: TOI-1288 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-1288 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (78, 83, 85) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 365733349, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 10-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 10-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
